title: Aerobic run + descent strength
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 65min at 140-150bpm, cadence 172+.
GYM: eccentric step-downs 3x10/side (3s down, 20cm box), single-leg squat 2x8/side, Copenhagen 2x30s/side, calf raises 3x15 single-leg.
FUEL: water.
GARMIN: ~80-95.
STOP RULE: late return Wed evening and under 6h sleep, run 50min and keep the gym.
WHY: step-downs are the knee's insurance for Saturday's 900m and VWT's last 8km of descent.
